description: Issue #324's pinned retrieval fixture: one run's Issue Working Memory for issue 2 (trailing commas in config lists) beside issue 3's records, with retracted, withheld, superseded, corrected, candidate-bound and foreign records as adversarial negatives. Relevance is judged by hand, per query, over the records the launch may be served.

records.text: Prefer small commits: one behavioural change per commit, each with its test.
The config parser rejects trailing commas because tokenize_list stops at the first empty element.
Stripping commas with a regex before parsing broke quoted strings that contain commas; reverted.
Validation failed: tests/test_config.py::test_trailing_comma raised ConfigSyntaxError on the candidate.
Run the suite with uv run pytest; plain pytest picks up the system interpreter and misses the locked dependencies.
Lint uses ruff with a 100 character line limit; ruff format must pass before every commit.
Empty list elements should raise a typed ConfigSyntaxError that names the line and column.
Next step: add a parametrized test for nested lists with trailing commas in tests/test_config.py.
mypy runs in strict mode on src only; the tests are not type checked.
Catching ValueError around json.loads hid the line number of the syntax error; do not wrap it.
The tokenizer drops the final element when a list ends with a comma followed by a newline.
On the earlier candidate the scanner looped forever on a lone separator.
Windows CRLF endings cause the trailing comma failure.
The bug is in the YAML loader, not in the list tokenizer.
The YAML loader is not involved: the failure reproduces with the INI reader alone.
Fixture files live in the samples directory.
Cache folders under .pytest_cache can hold stale bytecode; clear them when imports look wrong.
Cache folders under .pytest_cache can hold stale bytecode; clear them when imports look wrong.
Every change to the parser keeps the public parse_config signature unchanged.
Benchmarks in benchmarks/parse_speed.py are not part of the suite; never run them in validation.
A Unicode BOM at the start of the file shifts the reported columns by one.
Raising SyntaxError instead of ConfigSyntaxError broke the error formatter of the CLI.
Validation failed: ruff check reported E501 in src/config/tokens.py on the candidate.
The CLI prints parse errors through format_config_error; keep its message format stable for the docs.
Remaining work: document trailing comma support in docs/configuration.md.
Trailing commas in HTTP header lists are legal; the retry parser must keep them.
Run the suite with uv run pytest -k http to keep it under a minute.
The retry backoff doubles each attempt up to thirty seconds.
Windows CRLF endings break the HTTP fixture parser.

operations.reason: disproved: the failure reproduces with LF endings
the INI reader reproduces it alone
